arb.connection_androidDisconnectHint: If Android keeps the VPN active, turn off Always-on VPN in the settings that open.
arb.protection_guideWhy: This protection prevents apps from using the internet directly if the VPN disconnects. It is configured in Android.
arb.protection_guideAlwaysOn: Android keeps the VPN service running and can restart it after the phone reboots.
arb.protection_guideBlock: This setting prevents traffic from bypassing the VPN, including while the connection is interrupted.
arb.protection_guideWarning: With this blocking enabled, internet access stays off until the VPN is connected.
arb.protection_guideStep1: Open Android VPN settings with the button below.
arb.protection_guideStep2: Open the options using the gear icon beside FuzeVPN.
arb.protection_guideStep3: Enable Always-on VPN, then Block connections without VPN, if these options are available.
arb.protection_guideManufacturers: Names vary by phone. If needed, search for VPN in Settings, often under Network & internet.
arb.protection_guideDisable: In the same settings, turn off blocking without VPN to allow internet access without the VPN. Also turn off Always-on VPN if you no longer want Android to restart it.
arb.protection_guideManual: You choose these settings in Android. FuzeVPN does not change them for you.
